Campaigns

Six branded search campaigns across HR and medical software, each owned from vendor research and keywords through ad copy, landing pages, bidding and scaling.

Conversion tracking rebuild

Google Tag Manager, HubSpot Forms, Google Ads and Microsoft Ads, rolled out across every lead generation category at Software Finder.

The problem

Conversions were tracked with thank-you page triggers. A tag fired only when a visitor loaded a vendor-specific thank-you URL after submitting a form.

  • Lost conversionsIf the thank-you page loaded slowly, failed or the visitor closed the tab early, the lead reached HubSpot but the conversion never reached the ad platforms.
  • Weak bidding signalsSmart Bidding was optimizing on incomplete data, so Google and Bing could not properly learn which searches produced leads.

The fix

I rebuilt conversion tracking around the form submission itself, not the page that follows it.

  • Custom HTML listenerA GTM listener detects HubSpot form submissions the moment they happen, independent of any page load.
  • Data layer eventOn submission it pushes a form_submission event carrying the form data, including the lead's category.
  • Category-based triggersOne custom event trigger per vertical covers every vendor in it, rolled out across every category in the business.
  • Consolidated tagsGoogle Ads and Microsoft Ads conversion tags now fire from the same reliable event.

  • No lost conversionsEvery submitted lead is reported to the ad platforms, whatever happens to the next page.
  • Stronger bidding signalsTarget CPA and Target ROAS campaigns get complete data to optimize against.
  • Scales with new vendorsAdding a vendor needs no new trigger, since the category trigger already covers it.
  • One source of truthGoogle Ads and Microsoft Ads count conversions from the same event, across every category.
